name: sik-radio-tools
description: SiK telemetry radio configurator — web, desktop, Android USB, and iOS BLE

scripts.mobile:android:dev: npm run build:desktop && node scripts/prepare-android.js && tauri android dev
scripts.mobile:android:build: npm run build:desktop && node scripts/prepare-android.js && tauri android build

scripts.mobile:ios:build: npm run build:desktop && tauri ios build
